title: is a hot dog a sandwich, settle this

messages.content: is a hot dog a sandwich, settle this once and for all!

The classic debate! Technically, a hot dog fits the broad definition of a sandwich: meat between slices or halves of a roll. However, many argue that cultural and culinary contexts set it apart as its own category. So, while it might be classified as a sandwich in some circles, it's usually considered distinct by enthusiasts. Good luck settling your group chat!
